## Context

AI assistants were available to the team but used without shared rules.

## Problem

Without conventions the results were inconsistent and hard to review.

## Solution

A shared set of skills and a workflow that starts from a written specification.

## My role

I defined the approach, wrote the shared skills and coached the team.

## Technical decisions

Skills instead of raw prompts, and a review step before every merge.

## Trade-offs

Writing the specification first is slower at the start and faster at the end.

## Impact

The team has a common baseline to evaluate new tools against.

## What I'd do differently

I would involve the reviewers from the first week.
